subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Smashing the first red rock on the left on the path to the cliff face of Death Mountain with the Megaton Hammer at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Drop down from the peak of Death Mountain to the long path leading up to the cliff face, where you are normally pelted with burning rocks while trying to make your way up.  Smash the first red rock on the left with the Megaton Hammer, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula (if it isn't there, then make sure it's nighttime).

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Smashing the red rock on the cliff above Dodongo's Cavern with the Megaton Hammer at night reveals another Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head for the cliff above Dodongo's Cavern (where you threw the Bomb Flower down as Young Link to unseal Dodongo's Cavern).  There's another red rock here. Smash it with the Megaton Hammer to find another Gold Skulltula (again, it must be nighttime).

subject: Death Mountain
text: Playing the Prelude of Light on Death Mountain returns you to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: You're done on Death Mountain now, so play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located high on the south wall of Zora's River, reachable by jumping to a cliff ledge with a pit in it and using the Hookshot at night.

evidence.quote: If it isn't nighttime, then play the Sun's Song now, face the south wall and look up.  You'll see a Gold Skulltula high on the wall.  Unfortunately, you can't reach it from here....At the top, face south again where you will see a cliff with a pit in it.  Jump out to this ledge, but avoid the pit.  You're now in range of that Gold Skulltula that we passed earlier.  Make it nighttime if you need to, then nail the Gold Skulltula and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the northwestern wall near the end of the wooden drawbridge before the Zora's Domain waterfall, obtainable with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Near the end of the wooden drawbridge just before the waterfall, if you look on the northwestern wall you will find another Gold Skulltula.  You may need to stand on the fence to reach it with the Hookshot.

subject: Zora's Domain waterfall
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at the Zora's Domain waterfall opens the waterfall and grants entry to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: Once you have both of the Skulltulas in this zone, head to the Zora's Domain waterfall, play Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall and enter Zora's Domain.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located to the left of the very edge of the waterfall near King Zora's throne room and can be killed and collected with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Head to the left towards the top of the waterfall, and edge to the very edge of the waterfall.  Look to the left to see a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot, then return to King Zora's throne room.

subject: King Zora's throne room
text: The passage behind King Zora's throne leads into Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Climb up to the passage behind King Zora's throne and enter Zora's Fountain.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart is located across a second set of steadily rotating ice platforms reached by heading north-east across the frozen platforms from Jabu-Jabu's vacated altar.

evidence.quote: Climb up the small bit of frozen hill, and jump out onto the first of many frozen platforms.  Jump carefully along the ice platforms, and when you reach the second one, you can choose to go north or north-east.  Go north-east first to get a Piece of Heart.  The second set of ice platforms on the way to the Piece of Heart steadily rotates.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Navigating north across the ice platforms to the northern edge of the pond leads to a massive cave mouth that enters the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Piece of Heart, head back to the giant platform and go north along the ice platforms.  Jump along them to the northern edge of the pond and into the massive cave mouth that has appeared here.  Enter the cave mouth to reach the Ice Cavern.

subject: Freezzard
text: Freezzard enemies can freeze Link with an ice breath attack, but can be pulled toward Link with the Hookshot and defeated with sword strikes or Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: When the room widens out into a large room with a frozen floor, you'll meet three Freezzard enemies. Defeat them with sword strikes or Din's Fire.  Don't try to struggle towards them on the frozen ice.  Just use the Hookshot on them to pull yourself right to them.  The Freezzards can freeze you solid using an ice breath attack, and can move slowly around on the frozen floors, but are otherwise relatively harmless.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees in the room with the spinning Giant Frozen Scythe Thing of Incredibly Painful Death unlocks the door at the top of the cliff.

evidence.quote: This room contains a number of Silver Rupees, which must be gathered to unlock the door in the north end of the room so that you can progress onwards....The door at the top of the cliff will now unlock.  Climb up and go through it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ceiling above the silver rupee behind three blue stalagmites in the scythe room.

evidence.quote: There is another silver rupee behind three blue stalagmites in the corner (to the left as you first enter the room).  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the ceiling above while you grab this rupee.

subject: Ice Keese
text: Ice Keese freeze Link on contact without losing their ice effect, and should be defeated from afar using arrows.

evidence.quote: This room contains a new kind of Keese, the Ice Keese.  These guys are annoying.  Really freaking annoying.  If they touch you, then they will freeze you solid.  However, unlike the Fire Keese, they do not lose their Ice effect after they touch you.  Try and kill them from afar with arrows.

subject: Blue Fire
text: A pillar of Blue Fire in the Ice Keese room can be stored in empty Bottles and used to melt Red Ice.

evidence.quote: This platform contains a pillar which houses a pillar of Blue Fire.  Blue fire can be used to melt the Red Ice that you've seen around Zora's Domain.  Empty two of your Bottles (you'd better have at least two by this point in the game), and fill them with Blue Fire.
